# FutureMarketingAI (FMai)

> FMai builds Clyde, the AI colleague of your agency (Dutch: AI-collega). Clyde works in a loop per client: goals and strategy, research, a content agenda per channel, execution (Clyde creates, the team and the client approve) and reporting that feeds the next goal. 12 skills (10 live, 2 coming soon) and a memory per client. Workspace-priced model since 2026-04-28: Founding Member 997 EUR per month, rate fixed while you remain a client, 10 workspaces included (maximum 10 founding spots), Growth 499 EUR per workspace (2 to 4 brands), Professional 399 EUR per workspace (5 to 14 brands), Enterprise 299 EUR per workspace (15 plus brands). Servers and database in the EU; the language model runs at Anthropic and OpenAI (US). A setup with Mistral, a European language model, can be built on request. Application-gated: no self-service signup.

FMai is an AI marketing partnership founded by Daley for marketing agencies in the Netherlands and the EU with 5 to 20 people managing 5 to 20 client brands. Instead of isolated AI tools, FMai provides one AI colleague named Clyde who knows the goals of every client, works in every screen of the dashboard and on WhatsApp, and keeps a memory per client. Per task the agency decides what Clyde proposes first and what he may do himself and report. The agency's client gets their own dashboard, approves there, sends requests to the agency and talks to Clyde on WhatsApp. The first client is SkinClarity Club: 3 Instagram accounts, all 10 live skills switched on, and FutureMarketingAI is the agency that approves the content.

The product is not a self-serve SaaS. Every engagement starts with an application at https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply. Daley reviews personally within 48 hours.

Pricing canon: `fma-app/src/lib/skills.ts` revision 2026-04-28. Workspace-priced tiers recalibrated every 6 months based on observed credit usage. Existing contracts not retroactively adjusted.

Contact: hello@future-marketing.ai. Canonical domain: https://future-marketing.ai. Languages: Dutch (source of truth), English.

## Core pages

- [Home (NL)](https://future-marketing.ai/nl): Clyde, the loop from client goal to report, the team and the client, the entrances (dashboard, WhatsApp and the web app on your home screen), from post to lead, control and EU data, FAQ.
- [Memory](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/memory): How Clyde keeps a memory per client: the conversation, memories from conversations and feedback, strategy and research per client. Memories about a client belong to that agency and that client.
- [Pricing](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/pricing): What Clyde costs. The offer today is Founding (section #founding): 997 EUR per month, 10 workspaces (client brands) included, 299 EUR per extra workspace, 8000 credits per month, 0 EUR onboarding, rate fixed while you remain a client, monthly cancellable, maximum 10 spots. Once the 10 spots are taken, new agencies pay per workspace: Growth 499 EUR (2 to 4 brands, onboarding 1997 EUR), Professional 399 EUR (5 to 14 brands, onboarding 3997 EUR), Enterprise 299 EUR (15 plus brands, onboarding 5997 EUR), each with 800 credits per workspace per month. Those rates are recalibrated every 6 months.
- [Alternatives (NL)](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/alternatives): Honest comparison with Lindy, Sintra, GoSocio and aicollegas.nl, checked 2026-11-03: what each does, its price, how it handles multiple clients and data, and when it suits an agency better than Clyde.
- [Apply](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply): Application form for partnership. Name, email, agency and role are required; the rest is optional. Response within 48 hours.
- [How it works](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/how-it-works): 4-week onboarding, a workspace per client, approvals and control per task, a correction loop in the first month.
- [About](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/about): Founder Daley. Why partnership over SaaS.
- [Cases](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/case-studies): Two real clients with FutureMarketingAI as the agency: SkinClarity Club (skincare, 3 Instagram accounts, May to October 2026) and SalesLobe (B2B, the brand's Instagram and the founder's LinkedIn, since October 2026). No revenue, reach or lead figures.
- [Case: SkinClarity Club](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/case-studies/skinclarity-club): Our first client, with FutureMarketingAI as the agency. From May to October 2026 Clyde made the posts for 3 Instagram accounts (the club, the webshop and the skin therapist), each in its own voice, from one memory; a post went live only after approval in the app. Shows the real calendar of the week of 12 October 2026.
- [Case: SalesLobe](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/case-studies/saleslobe): B2B client, with FutureMarketingAI as the agency. Since 5 October 2026 Clyde makes the brand's Instagram and the LinkedIn of founder Paul den Hartogh, in English, each post approved in the app before it goes live. Shows one topic in both voices (a LinkedIn post of 23 October and an Instagram carousel of 27 October 2026) and the voice round that came first. No revenue, reach or lead figures.
- [Contact](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/contact): Simple form. For partnership inquiries use Apply instead.

## 12 Skills

- [Social Media Manager](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/social-media): Captions in brand voice, a content calendar per account, carousels in the house style and performance per post. Publishes to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, TikTok and YouTube after approval. Live.
- [Blog Factory](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/blog-factory): SEO articles from keyword research to publication after approval; length follows the search intent. Live.
- [Ad Manager](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/ad-manager): Static and video ads prepared for Meta, live only after approval, then followed per ad on conversions, ROAS and ad fatigue. Live.
- [Reel Builder](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/reel-builder): Short vertical videos with script, captions and music. Coming soon.
- [Voice Agent](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/voice-agent): AI phone calls for appointments, questions and handover to a person. Coming soon.
- [Lead Qualifier](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/lead-qualifier): Instagram comments and DMs with a keyword get a DM with the matching link; Clyde writes the follow-up in the brand voice for approval, and leads from the link land in the lead list. Live.
- [Email Management](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/email-management): Gmail and Outlook inbox classification with labels and draft replies sent after approval. Live.
- [ManyChat DM](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/manychat): Instagram DMs, comments and story replies with keyword triggers, AI drafts in the brand voice and lead capture. Live.
- [Reporting and Analytics](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/reporting): A weekly report per brand, a dashboard per client refreshed daily, and an alert on strong deviations. Live.
- [SEO / GEO Analyst](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/seo-geo): Technical SEO, positions from Search Console, Core Web Vitals and AI citation monitoring. Live.
- [Research](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/research): Scheduled research per client on market, trends and competitors, with a source link per insight. Live.
- [Clyde](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/clyde): The AI colleague who routes plain-language requests to the right skill, in the dashboard, in the web app on your home screen and on WhatsApp. Live.
